title: Instrument prospective T5 FNP rows from frozen existing decisions
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic prospective row producer and validator that lets existing T5 FNP_CUMULATIVE record genuine decision divergence, frozen horizons and later outcome attachment from already-authoritative decision/evidence artifacts. Do not create new actions, thresholds, asset-tier semantics or classifications. Fail closed when divergence, lineage, frozen horizons or required observations are unavailable.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/learning/directly related T5 FNP row producer and validator
06_RESEARCH_LAB/forward_tests/directly related machine-readable T5 runtime artifact if an existing owner path requires it

evidence.summary: T5 is ACTIVE_NEEDS_ROWS; required fields include frozen_horizon, asset_tier, blocked_action, benchmark_action, actual_cost, drawdown_avoided, missed_upside and final_classification; blocker is ROW_PRODUCTION.
Existing append-only owner requires genuine action divergence, frozen 24h/72h/7d horizons and forbids retrospective horizon/action rewriting. Current valid row count is zero.

Current main already materializes immutable Action Compass outcomes and descriptive exit-warning opportunity-cost calibration; T5 should consume existing frozen authority rather than invent a parallel decision engine.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect T5 in the Active Test Registry and the Offensive Divergence/FNP owner. Verify T5 remains blocked by ROW_PRODUCTION with insufficient rows. Search current scripts/workflows for a deterministic producer that creates source-bound prospective T5 divergence rows before outcomes and attaches outcomes only after frozen horizons mature. If such a complete producer already exists, stop as clean no-op; otherwise implement only the missing instrumentation using existing authoritative decision artifacts.

positive: A synthetic eligible decision divergence with pre-outcome lineage produces exactly one immutable prospective T5 source row with frozen horizons and no outcome fields populated early.

After a frozen horizon matures with source-bound evidence, the existing row receives or is paired with an immutable outcome artifact that can compute missed_upside/drawdown_avoided without selecting the horizon retrospectively.
Replay of the same frozen decision is deduplicated and does not create a second valid row.
negative: No row is valid when benchmark and experimental/current actions do not genuinely diverge.
Missing required lineage, asset tier, frozen horizon or outcome evidence fails closed as DATA_INSUFFICIENT/BLOCKED and does not count as a valid outcome row.

The implementation cannot create or modify market gates, thresholds, action semantics, portfolio sizing, canonical phase state or final classification rules beyond what the existing owner explicitly defines.
